text:
emma_procurement: Hey team — trying to pay vendor invoice INV-9843 with our company P-card and it keeps declining. Customer-facing error: 'Payment declined by issuer'. Screenshot attached.
jamal_billing: Can you drop the transaction timestamp, amount, and last4? Also was this via the self-serve invoice link or manual card charge?

emma_procurement: Manual charge from billing portal. Amount $12,400. Timestamp 2026-03-17 14:12:03 UTC. Card last4 4321.
lina_support: Thanks — pinging @payments-bot to pull gateway response and @sre_oncall in case it's a rate/velocity block.
payments-bot: webhook: /v1/charges -> 402

```
{ "status": "declined", "decline_code": "05", "network_message": "DO NOT HONOUR", "processor": "acme-pay", "gateway_tx": "gw_tx_7f9b" }
```
sre_oncall: 05 / DO NOT HONOUR usually issuer-side. Two common causes: fraud/velocity or merchant descriptor flagged. Can you share vendor merchant name and MCC?

emma_procurement: Vendor: Evergreen Cloud Services, MCC shown on invoice page: 4814 (Telecom). The vendor's processor shows MCC 4814 when we hit the invoice link. Customer says bank says 'merchant category mismatch' on call.
jamal_billing: Interesting — our billing logs show vendor registered as 'Cloud infra' but when the gateway forwarded it, acme-pay set descriptor to "EVRG-CHARITY" for recurring billing (weird). That descriptor can trigger charity/non-profit flags at some issuers.
lina_support: Okay — two follow ups: 1) reproduce via sandbox with same vendor descriptor, 2) ask issuer (card BIN) if they have an MCC-based block.
sre_oncall: What's BIN? last6?

emma_procurement: Last6 400005, BIN 400005.
lina_support: Attempting repro — running a test charge against the sandbox using the same gateway_tx params.
```
curl -X POST https://payments.internal/v1/charges \
  -d '{"amount":12400,"currency":"usd","card_last4":"4321","card_bin":"400005","merchant_descriptor":"EVRG-CHARITY","metadata":{"invoice":"INV-9843"}}'
```
payments-bot: sandbox response -> 402 decline_code=05, note: "merchant_descriptor blocked by issuer policy"
```
{ "decline_code":"05","issuer_note":"MCC_BLOCK","gateway_tx":"gw_test_22" }
```

sre_oncall: Confirms issuer side MCC/descriptor block. Two remediation paths: ask vendor to normalize descriptor to match MCC 4814 (or a cloud infra descriptor), or request a one-off issuer override for this outbound charge. For now we can do a manual invoice charge via the customer's bank (if they approve) or set a temporary merchant allowlist.
jamal_billing: We can add a temporary allowlist on our gateway for vendor_id vendor_9843 for this invoice and retry — that should bypass descriptor rewrite. I'll open the support ticket with acme-pay to request a permanent descriptor fix.
lina_support: Emma, do you want us to retry payment now if you confirm email approval from the cardholder?

emma_procurement: Yes please retry. Cardholder approved. Also can we avoid putting 'CHARITY' in descriptors for corporate invoices.
jamal_billing: Doing manual retry now — creating gateway override token `ovr_2026_red_753` linked to invoice INV-9843. Retrying...
payments-bot: retry -> 200
```
{ "status":"succeeded","gateway_tx":"gw_tx_7f9b_retry","amount":12400 }
```

lina_support: Payment succeeded. Created follow-up: billing ticket #BILL-1127 to request vendor descriptor normalization with acme-pay, and ops ticket #OPS-621 to add vendor_9843 to temporary allowlist until descriptor is fixed. Case opened with issuer as well: ISS-2026-RED-153.

emma_procurement: Confirmed payment went through — thank you :white_check_mark:
jamal_billing: Closing thread once descriptor fix is in place. Action items added to tickets above. :calendar:
sre_oncall: Recommend adding a quick checklist for procurement cards: verify descriptor, BIN velocity rules, and MCC mapping before manual retries. I'll add to runbook.

lina_support: Closing here — summary:
- Root cause: issuer declined due to merchant descriptor/MCC mismatch (issuer flagged descriptor as charity)
- Short-term fix: gateway allowlist + manual retry (ovr_2026_red_753)
- Long-term: vendor descriptor normalization and bank case (BILL-1127, OPS-621, ISS-2026-RED-153)

:lock: Metadata: invoice=INV-9843, vendor_id=vendor_9843, gateway_tx=gw_tx_7f9b, override=ovr_2026_red_753
